name: Benin

fees.name: e-Visa, 30 days, single entry
fees.applies: all nationalities not visa-exempt (all African nationals are visa-free)
fees.notes: Official portal evisa.bj (redirects to evisa-ng.gouv.bj). Fee schedule from the portal's 'Les couts des visas d'entree au Benin' article: 50 EUR (approx 32,798 FCFA). Portal blocked direct fetch; amount corroborated by MFA honorary-consulate fiche (embassy-assisted rate 60 EUR = 50 + 10 EUR service surcharge).

fees.name: e-Visa, 30 days, multiple entry
fees.notes: Approx 49,197 FCFA. Embassy-assisted applications (no bank card) pay 85 EUR (10 EUR surcharge).

fees.name: e-Visa, 90 days, multiple entry
fees.notes: Approx 65,596 FCFA. Embassy-assisted applications pay 110 EUR (10 EUR surcharge).

fees.name: Embassy-assisted e-visa (traveller without bank card)
fees.validity: 30 days single entry (85 EUR for 30-day multiple, 110 EUR for 90-day multiple)
fees.applies: travellers applying through a Benin embassy/consulate because they lack a bank card
fees.notes: Benin has abolished sticker visas: visa applications are exclusively electronic (per beninembassy.us). Embassies only assist with e-visa filing for a fixed 10 EUR service fee, bringing totals to 60/85/110 EUR.

fees.name: Visa on arrival
fees.notes: No visa on arrival: the Benin visa application is done exclusively electronically via the official e-visa platform; visa must be obtained before travel.

free_visa_notes: Citizens of all African countries and territories are visa-exempt for stays up to 90 days (ECOWAS/UEMOA free movement extended to all of Africa), so IND/USA/GBR/CHN/RUS/etc. pay the flat EUR e-visa fees while NGA and other African nationals enter free. Fees are flat by visa type with no nationality-based reciprocity schedule. Confidence marked medium because the official portal (evisa-ng.gouv.bj) refused automated fetches; the 50/75/100 EUR schedule was confirmed via the portal's indexed fee article and the Benin MFA honorary-consulate information sheet (which documents the +10 EUR embassy-assisted totals of 60/85/110 EUR).
